steps.title: Make two holes in the wall or ceiling. Hole sizes and spacing as shown.
Push the expansion screws into the wall or ceiling.
Fix the fixture on the wall or ceiling and adjust the angle.
Connect the cable in the bracket holder to the municipal (supply) wire, as shown in the wiring diagram.
